name: quiz-tanhoa
description: Hội thi nghiệp vụ cán bộ, công chức xã Tân Hòa

scripts.deploy:cloud: npm run build:cloud && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 pages deploy frontend/dist-web --project-name quiztanhoa --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:cloud:preview: npm run build:cloud && npx --yes wrangler@4.162.0 pages deploy frontend/dist-web --project-name quiztanhoa --branch verify --commit-dirty=true
scripts.setup: npm --prefix frontend ci && dotnet restore backend/Quiz_TanHoa.Api.csproj
scripts.build:web: npm --prefix frontend run build:web && dotnet publish backend/Quiz_TanHoa.Api.csproj -c Release -o publish/web
scripts.build:desktop: npm --prefix frontend run build && dotnet publish backend/Quiz_TanHoa.Api.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o publish/backend
scripts.test:development: dotnet build backend/Quiz_TanHoa.Api.csproj -c Debug --artifacts-path .artifacts/development && node scripts/test-development.cjs
scripts.test: dotnet build backend/Quiz_TanHoa.Api.csproj -c Release && npm run test:auth && npm run test:competitions && npm run test:exams && npm run test:assignments && npm run test:results && npm --prefix frontend run build:web && npm run test:development && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:topics: dotnet build backend/Quiz_TanHoa.Api.csproj -c Release --artifacts-path .artifacts/topics && node scripts/test-topics.cjs
